inputs.description: Release tag to (re)publish, e.g. v1.2.3 (leave blank to build the current branch)

tasks.label: Release: Bump Version & Tag
tasks.detail: Bumps pyproject.toml/uv.lock version, commits, and creates the vX.Y.Z tag locally.

tasks.label: Release: Push Tags to Origin
tasks.detail: Pushes the commit and tag, triggering the release + PyPI publish workflows.

tasks.label: Release: Publish Now (manual dispatch)
tasks.detail: Manually (re)triggers the publish-to-PyPI workflow, e.g. if CI failed.
